warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor quality-v2 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0073; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Quality-v2 remediation rechecked learner-facing English, removed known weak/teacher-directive patterns where present, and kept the bounded target pragmatically licensed by its prompt.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: دادن accurately represents causing another person to have the drink.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The Lesson introduces one lexical target and reuses familiar can plus drink vocabulary.

distractorQuality.evidence: Placeholder/generic distractors were removed where present; choices use contrastive alternatives with distinct teaching feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The scene and adjacent turns were checked again so character prompts function as dialogue rather than teacher commands.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances remain short, reuse established A1 language, and add only the bounded target planned for this Lesson.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The cafe arc returns five Lessons after 0068 and rotates the learner role from Ben to Ava.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner keeps give stable and changes the item from coffee to tea.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities, retrieval task, and stated outcome all point to the same bounded learning goal.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; boredom, perceived difficulty and retention remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review is limited to the bounded A1 outcome and does not claim broad mastery of the target word or grammar.
Final generated audio prosody is not evaluated in this text-stage review.
No independent human or real learner test has been performed after quality-v2 remediation.
resolvedFindings: English target usage is contextually plausible for the authored scene.
Persian copy preserves the intended bounded meaning without adding a second target.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval in a changed controlled context.
